title: Multi-Turn LLM Conversations under the Least-Recently-Used Policy: Mean-Field Asymptotics and Hit Ratio Approximation
summary: The major workloads in modern large language model (LLM) serving systems have shifted from single-shot LLM calls to multi-turn conversations, where new responses are generated based on the whole conversation history across all previous turns. The hit ratio, i.e., the average fraction of KV caches accessed directly from existing caches stored in high-bandwidth memory (HBM), is hence a crucial metric that governs system performance.
